 “Baby, It’s Cold Outside” — And We Mean It 
 By Jaren L. Smith Published : Nov. 13, 2026 at 7:14 AM CST | Updated : 10 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google QUINCY (WGEM) - 
 Here’s the deal: Once the high pressure system moves in from the north, temperatures will plummet tonight. We’re talking a hard freeze, with lows dipping into the low to mid-20s, and not to mention, some of our coldest spots potentially hitting the upper teens. Bundle up if you’re heading out after dark to Friday night football, but honestly you could stay in and enjoy one of your favorite movies with some hot chocolate.
 Lows in the 20's, light winds, and partly cloudy skies. We could see some frost in the morning. (maxuser | WGEM) The good news: This cold snap is short-lived. Saturday and Sunday bring sunshine and gradually warming temperatures in the upper 40s to low 50s. By Tuesday, we’ll be back to seasonal norms in the mid-50s, and by Wednesday, we could see highs near 60 degrees.
 Staying chilly, but slow warm up starting next week. (maxuser | WGEM) What you need to do: Grab your winter coat the entire weekend! If you have pets or plants, bring them inside or protect them from the cold. It’s the perfect weekend for hot cocoa and staying cozy indoors — or at least dressing in layers if you venture out.
 The cold is here, but it’s leaving town just as fast as it arrived. Stay warm out there!
